The '''''Steadfast''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:LockUnderAttack-GI.jpg|thumb|left|230px|General Koth and his men during the [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|Capture of Eeth Koth]].]] The ''Steadfast'' saw service in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]. During the [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|battle]] near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]], the ''Steadfast'' was the location where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Eeth Koth was captured by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
